# Offline, reproducible FreeType matches the Python baseline's rasterizer. Verified release archive, FTL.
set(_ft_archive "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/freetype-2.14.3.tar.xz")
file(SHA256 "${_ft_archive}" _ft_hash)
if(NOT _ft_hash STREQUAL "36bc4f1cc413335368ee656c42afca65c5a3987e8768cc28cf11ba775e785a5f")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The pinned FreeType source archive changed")
endif()
set(_ft_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source/freetype-2.14.3")
if(NOT EXISTS "${_ft_source}/CMakeLists.txt")
  file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_ft_archive}" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source")
endif()
# Keep the upstream archive immutable; deterministic, licensed local safety override.
configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/overrides/pngshim.c" "${_ft_source}/src/sfnt/pngshim.c" COPYONLY)
configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/overrides/sfwoff2.c" "${_ft_source}/src/sfnt/sfwoff2.c" COPYONLY)
set(FT_DISABLE_HARFBUZZ ON CACHE BOOL "Match baseline FreeType without HarfBuzz autofitter dependency" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
add_subdirectory("${_ft_source}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/library" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(Freetype::Freetype ALIAS freetype)
set_target_properties(freetype PROPERTIES C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
if(GENKO_SANITIZE AND NOT MSVC)
  target_compile_options(freetype PRIVATE -fsanitize=${GENKO_SANITIZE} -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined)
  target_link_options(freetype PRIVATE -fsanitize=${GENKO_SANITIZE})
endif()
